title: Owl on a jump rope
description: Horseman of death, cult meme that spread out in 2026
body:
## Owl on a jumping rope / Сова на скакалке ![MC](https://img.shields.io/badge/minecraft-26.2-2a2?style=flat) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat) ![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/deforcy/Owl-on-a-jump-rope) ![Maintenance](https://img.shields.io/badge/Maintained%3F-yes-green.svg) We will not explain the meme itself, do not ask us for it - you can look this up yourself ![Meme showup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd1d973026bdd5ae97c3ceb7bf12e5706cd68501_0.webp)
This mod adds three items (for now), all found in their own **Owl on a Jump Rope** creative tab: - **Owl on a jumping rope card** - the horseman of death. - **Uno Reverse Card** - your best friend - **Deck of cards** (8 uses) - drops an "owl on a jump rope" card in front of you. ### Crafting There are currently two recipes: **Uno Reverse Card** - paper ring around a redstone: ![Uno reverse card craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/268ded5493fbf834c39ef8e723d2b26668951c7d.png) **Deck of cards** - paper ring around a book: ![Deck of cards craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e51bb170575f53ede3a5add3a2f63499efff65ea.png)
Need help? join [discord](https://discord.gg/ehBR2f4ufD)
